one_liner: Cloud accounting software for small businesses to manage invoicing, expenses, and financial reporting.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 is used for authentication and authorization against the Intuit Financial Ecosystem.
access_notes: Sign up for a free Intuit Developer account to create an app and get sandbox credentials.
api_notes: Covers accounting, payments, and company info endpoints via REST APIs.
blocker_notes: Public documentation and free self-serve developer sandboxes are available.

auth.quote: OAuth 2.0 is our authorization standard. Only registered apps can connect to the Intuit OAuth2.0 server, call our API, and end-users’ QuickBooks Online companies.

access.quote: Besides the sandbox environment tied to your developer account, you can use Postman to test REST API production code and endpoints.

api.quote: For the QuickBooks Online Accounting API: sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com For the QuickBooks Payments: sandbox.api.intuit.com

verdict.quote:
Step 1: Set up your app in the Developer Portal
If you haven’t already, sign in to your developer account and create your app.
